    Read a table as a tibble

    Source: R/rows.R, R/dtable-methods.R
    hb_read_table.Rd

    Reads all rows from table (optionally filtered by view) and returns them as a typed tibble. Pagination is handled internally; the returned tibble always has the table's columns in declared order plus an _id column.

    Usage

    hb_read_table(x, table, ...)

# S3 method for class 'harbour_dtable'
hb_read_table(x, table, ..., view = NULL, n_max = Inf, option_labels = TRUE)

# Default S3 method
hb_read_table(x, table, ...)

# S3 method for class 'harbour_client'
hb_read_table(x, table, ..., view = NULL, page_size = 1000L, n_max = Inf)

    Arguments

    x

    A harbour_client connected to a base, or a harbour_dtable read from a local file.

    table

    Name of the table.

    ...

    These dots are for future extensions and must be empty.

    view

    Optional view name. A server returns only the columns a view shows, so a read through a view gives NA for the columns it hides, and harbouR warns naming them. A .dtable read keeps their values.

    n_max

    Maximum number of rows to return. Inf, the default, reads the whole table.

    option_labels

    Translate select-option ids to their display names. On disk a select cell holds an option id; over the API it holds the name, so this is what makes a local read and a server read of the same column agree. Set FALSE to see the raw ids.

    page_size

    Rows fetched per request. SeaTable caps this at 1000 and harbouR clamps it, warning if you asked for more.

    Value

    A tibble with one row per SeaTable row and one column per SeaTable column, plus _id (chr). A 0-row tibble is returned for an empty table.

    Views on a .dtable file

    On a harbour_dtable, view restricts the rows only to the row ids the file records for that view, kept in table order. The view's filters and sorts are not applied. A view that records no rows returns the whole table, with a warning of class harbour_warning_view_filters when the view has filters that were therefore not applied.

    See also

    Other rows: hb_append_rows(), hb_delete_rows(), hb_get_row(), hb_lock_rows(), hb_query(), hb_unlock_rows(), hb_update_rows()

    Examples

    # a .dtable file needs no server
path <- system.file("extdata", "example.dtable", package = "harbouR")
base <- hb_read_dtable(path)
hb_read_table(base, "Samples")
#> # A tibble: 2 × 28
#>   Name  Notes           Concentration Share  Cost Preis Runtime Rating Consented
#>   <chr> <chr>                   <dbl> <dbl> <dbl> <dbl>   <dbl>  <int> <lgl>    
#> 1 S-001 A plain **mark…      0.000587  0.42  20.0  17.5    3661      4 TRUE     
#> 2 S-002 Rendered elsew…      8.1      NA     NA    NA        NA     NA FALSE    
#> # ℹ 19 more variables: Collected <dttm>, Status <chr>, Tags <list>,
#> #   Collaborators <list>, Photos <list>, Reports <list>, Where <list>,
#> #   Homepage <chr>, Contact <chr>, `Temperatur (°C)` <dbl>, Doubled <chr>,
#> #   Ref <chr>, `Created by` <chr>, `Changed by` <chr>, Created <dttm>,
#> #   Changed <dttm>, Action <list>, Signature <list>, `_id` <chr>
hb_read_table(base, "Samples", n_max = 1)
#> # A tibble: 1 × 28
#>   Name  Notes           Concentration Share  Cost Preis Runtime Rating Consented
#>   <chr> <chr>                   <dbl> <dbl> <dbl> <dbl>   <dbl>  <int> <lgl>    
#> 1 S-001 A plain **mark…      0.000587  0.42  20.0  17.5    3661      4 TRUE     
#> # ℹ 19 more variables: Collected <dttm>, Status <chr>, Tags <list>,
#> #   Collaborators <list>, Photos <list>, Reports <list>, Where <list>,
#> #   Homepage <chr>, Contact <chr>, `Temperatur (°C)` <dbl>, Doubled <chr>,
#> #   Ref <chr>, `Created by` <chr>, `Changed by` <chr>, Created <dttm>,
#> #   Changed <dttm>, Action <list>, Signature <list>, `_id` <chr>

# a live base needs a SeaTable server and an API token
if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
client <- hb_client()
hb_read_table(client, "Samples")

# just the first 10 rows
hb_read_table(client, "Samples", n_max = 10)
} # }
